mapper.sql: (SELECT U.TEAM_SN FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId})
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_PRP_TMMBR M WHERE M.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND M.USER_ID = #{userId})
CASE WHEN P.PBANC_STEP_CD = 'PP020' AND P.OPNN_DDLN_DT IS NOT NULL THEN P.OPNN_DDLN_DT ELSE P.BID_DDLN_DT END

P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, TRIM(P.PBANC_STTS_CD) AS statusCd, S.CD_NM AS statusNm, ST.CD_NM AS stepNm, R.CD_NM AS returnNm, TM.TEAM_NM AS teamNm, CASE WHEN P.PBANC_STEP_CD = 'PP020' AND P.OPNN_DDLN_DT IS NOT NULL THEN '의견등록 마감' WHEN P.BID_DDLN_DT IS NOT NULL THEN '제출 마감' END AS ddlnNm, TO_CHAR(, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS ddlnText, TRUNC() - TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS dday

FROM TB_BID_PBANC P LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD S ON S.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTS' AND S.CD = P.PBANC_STTS_CD LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD ST ON ST.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTP' AND ST.CD = P.PBANC_STEP_CD LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD R ON R.GROUP_CD = 'RTRSE' AND R.CD = P.RTRN_SE_CD LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM TM ON TM.TEAM_SN = P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN
NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_TOC C WHERE C.UP_TOC_SN = T.TOC_SN)
(P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS010' AND P.PBANC_STEP_CD IN ('PP010', 'PP020', 'PP030') AND NVL(P.PBANC_TYPE_CD, '-') <> 'PY040' AND NVL(P.TRCK_STTS_CD, '-') <> 'TR030')
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS assignWait, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS020' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS awaitingTeam, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN AND TRUNC() - TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN 0 AND 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS dueSoon, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS010' AND P.RTRN_SE_CD IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS returned, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN P.TRCK_STTS_CD = 'TR010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS tracking FROM TB_BID_PBANC P

SELECT
WHERE OR P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS020' ORDER BY , P.PBANC_SN FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

SELECT TM.TEAM_SN AS teamSn, TM.TEAM_NM AS teamNm, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS020' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS assigned, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN P.PBANC_STTS_CD IN ('PS030', 'PS040') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inProgress, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS050' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS submitted, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS060' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS resulted FROM TB_TEAM TM LEFT JOIN TB_BID_PBANC P ON P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN = TM.TEAM_SN WHERE TM.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND TM.TEAM_SN = (SELECT U.TEAM_SN FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId})
AND TM.DEPT_CD = 'DP030'
GROUP BY TM.TEAM_SN, TM.TEAM_NM ORDER BY TM.TEAM_SN

SELECT P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, TM.TEAM_NM AS teamNm, TRUNC(P.BID_DDLN_DT) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS dday, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SBMSN_DCMNT D WHERE D.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN) AS docTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SBMSN_DCMNT D WHERE D.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_ATCH_FILE F WHERE F.DCMNT_SN = D.DCMNT_SN AND F.DEL_YN = 'N')) AS docReady, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SBMSN_DCMNT D WHERE D.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND D.ESNTL_YN = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_ATCH_FILE F WHERE F.DCMNT_SN = D.DCMNT_SN AND F.DEL_YN = 'N')) AS missingRequired, CASE WHEN P.SBMSN_DT IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS registered FROM TB_BID_PBANC P LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM TM ON TM.TEAM_SN = P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN WHERE P.PBANC_STTS_CD IN ('PS030', 'PS040') ORDER BY P.BID_DDLN_DT, P.PBANC_SN FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, MAX(CASE WHEN P.OPENG_DT IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(P.OPENG_DT) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TRUNC(P.OPENG_DT) END) AS maxDays FROM TB_BID_PBANC P WHERE P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS050'

SELECT Y.YR AS yearNo, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BID_PBANC P WHERE P.PBANC_STTS_CD IN ('PS050', 'PS060', 'PS070') AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NVL(P.BID_DDLN_DT, P.OPENG_DT)) = Y.YR) AS submitted, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BID_RSLT R JOIN TB_BID_PBANC P ON P.PBANC_SN = R.PBANC_SN WHERE R.BID_RSLT_CD = 'BR010' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NVL(P.BID_DDLN_DT, P.OPENG_DT)) = Y.YR) AS won, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BID_RSLT R JOIN TB_BID_PBANC P ON P.PBANC_SN = R.PBANC_SN WHERE R.BID_RSLT_CD = 'BR020' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NVL(P.BID_DDLN_DT, P.OPENG_DT)) = Y.YR) AS lost, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BID_PBANC P WHERE P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS070' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NVL(P.BID_DDLN_DT, P.OPENG_DT)) = Y.YR) AS failed, (SELECT NVL(SUM(R.SCSBD_AMT), 0) FROM TB_BID_RSLT R JOIN TB_BID_PBANC P ON P.PBANC_SN = R.PBANC_SN WHERE R.BID_RSLT_CD = 'BR010' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NVL(P.BID_DDLN_DT, P.OPENG_DT)) = Y.YR) AS wonAmt FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - LEVEL + 1 AS YR FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 3) Y ORDER BY Y.YR

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BID_PBANC P WHERE P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS020' AND P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN = ) AS decisionWait, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BID_PBANC P WHERE P.PBANC_STTS_CD IN ('PS030', 'PS040', 'PS050') AND ) AS inProgress, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RQT_MTTR Q JOIN TB_BID_PBANC P ON P.PBANC_SN = Q.PBANC_SN WHERE Q.TOC_SN IS NULL AND P.PBANC_STTS_CD IN ('PS030', 'PS040') AND ) AS unmapped, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BID_PBANC P WHERE P.PBANC_STTS_CD IN ('PS030', 'PS040') AND AND TRUNC(P.BID_DDLN_DT) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN 0 AND 7) AS dueSoon FROM DUAL

SELECT P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, TRIM(P.PBANC_STTS_CD) AS statusCd, S.CD_NM AS statusNm, CASE WHEN MB.PTCP_SE_CD = 'PT010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS leadYn, TO_CHAR(P.BID_DDLN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS ddlnText, TRUNC(P.BID_DDLN_DT) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS dday, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TOC T WHERE T.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND ) AS tocTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TOC T WHERE T.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND AND T.PRGRS_STTS_CD = 'TS030') AS tocDone, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RQT_MTTR Q WHERE Q.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN) AS rqtTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RQT_MTTR Q WHERE Q.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND Q.TOC_SN IS NOT NULL) AS rqtMapped, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SBMSN_DCMNT D WHERE D.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN) AS docTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SBMSN_DCMNT D WHERE D.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_ATCH_FILE F WHERE F.DCMNT_SN = D.DCMNT_SN AND F.DEL_YN = 'N')) AS docReady, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_ATCH_FILE F WHERE F.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND F.FILE_SE_CD = 'FL030' AND F.LAST_YN = 'Y' AND F.DEL_YN = 'N') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS finalConfirmed FROM TB_BID_PBANC P JOIN TB_PRP_TMMBR MB ON MB.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND MB.USER_ID = #{userId} LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD S ON S.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTS' AND S.CD = P.PBANC_STTS_CD WHERE P.PBANC_STTS_CD IN ('PS030', 'PS040', 'PS050') ORDER BY P.BID_DDLN_DT, P.PBANC_SN FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

SELECT A.kind, A.pbancSn, A.pbancNm, A.sub, A.ddlnText, A.dday FROM ( SELECT 'DECISION' AS kind, 1 AS ord, P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, TM.TEAM_NM || ' 배정' AS sub, TO_CHAR(P.BID_DDLN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS ddlnText, TRUNC(P.BID_DDLN_DT) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS dday FROM TB_BID_PBANC P LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM TM ON TM.TEAM_SN = P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN WHERE P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS020' AND P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN = UNION ALL SELECT 'FINAL', 2, P.PBANC_SN, P.PBANC_NM, '통합본 ' || NVL(TO_CHAR((SELECT MAX(F.INTG_CYCL) FROM TB_ATCH_FILE F WHERE F.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND F.FILE_SE_CD = 'FL030' AND F.DEL_YN = 'N')), '1') || '차 · 확정 전', TO_CHAR(P.BID_DDLN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), TRUNC(P.BID_DDLN_DT) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) FROM TB_BID_PBANC P WHERE P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS040' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_PRP_TMMBR M WHERE M.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND M.USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.PTCP_SE_CD = 'PT010') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_ATCH_FILE F WHERE F.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND F.FILE_SE_CD = 'FL030' AND F.DEL_YN = 'N') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_ATCH_FILE F WHERE F.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND F.FILE_SE_CD = 'FL030' AND F.DEL_YN = 'N' AND F.LAST_YN = 'Y') UNION ALL SELECT 'DOCS', 3, P.PBANC_SN, P.PBANC_NM, '필수 서류 ' || X.CNT || '건 미비', TO_CHAR(P.BID_DDLN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), TRUNC(P.BID_DDLN_DT) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) FROM TB_BID_PBANC P JOIN (SELECT D.PBANC_SN, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TB_SBMSN_DCMNT D WHERE D.ESNTL_YN = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_ATCH_FILE F WHERE F.DCMNT_SN = D.DCMNT_SN AND F.DEL_YN = 'N') AND NVL(D.TKCG_SE_CD, 'TK020') = 'TK020' GROUP BY D.PBANC_SN) X ON X.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN WHERE P.PBANC_STTS_CD IN ('PS030', 'PS040') AND UNION ALL SELECT 'RQT', 4, P.PBANC_SN, P.PBANC_NM, '미매핑 요구사항 ' || X.CNT || '건', TO_CHAR(P.BID_DDLN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), TRUNC(P.BID_DDLN_DT) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) FROM TB_BID_PBANC P JOIN (SELECT Q.PBANC_SN, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TB_RQT_MTTR Q WHERE Q.TOC_SN IS NULL GROUP BY Q.PBANC_SN) X ON X.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN WHERE P.PBANC_STTS_CD IN ('PS030', 'PS040') AND UNION ALL SELECT 'RESULT', 5, P.PBANC_SN, P.PBANC_NM, CASE WHEN R.TECH_EVL_SCR IS NULL THEN '점수와 장단점이 아직 없어요' ELSE '장단점 분석이 아직 없어요' END, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(16)), CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) FROM TB_BID_PBANC P JOIN TB_BID_RSLT R ON R.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN WHERE P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS060' AND (R.TECH_EVL_SCR IS NULL OR R.STRPT_CN IS NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_PRP_TMMBR M WHERE M.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND M.USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.PTCP_SE_CD = 'PT010') ) A ORDER BY A.dday, A.ord, A.pbancSn FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY

SELECT P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, T.TOC_NO AS tocNo, T.TOC_NM AS tocNm, T.EXPC_PAGE_CNT AS expcPageCnt, TRIM(T.PRGRS_STTS_CD) AS tocStatusCd, C.CD_NM AS tocStatusNm, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ATCH_FILE F WHERE F.TOC_SN = T.TOC_SN AND F.DEL_YN = 'N') AS fileCnt, CASE WHEN P.BID_DDLN_DT IS NOT NULL THEN '제출 마감' END AS ddlnNm, TO_CHAR(P.BID_DDLN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS ddlnText, TRUNC(P.BID_DDLN_DT) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS dday FROM TB_TOC T JOIN TB_BID_PBANC P ON P.PBANC_SN = T.PBANC_SN LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD C ON C.GROUP_CD = 'TOCST' AND C.CD = T.PRGRS_STTS_CD WHERE T.PIC_ID = #{userId} AND P.PBANC_STTS_CD IN ('PS030', 'PS040') ORDER BY P.BID_DDLN_DT, P.PBANC_SN, T.SORT_SEQ FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY

SELECT P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, TRIM(P.PBANC_STTS_CD) AS statusCd, S.CD_NM AS statusNm, TO_CHAR(P.BID_DDLN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS ddlnText, TRUNC(P.BID_DDLN_DT) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS dday, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TOC T WHERE T.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND T.PIC_ID = #{userId}) AS myTocTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TOC T WHERE T.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND T.PIC_ID = #{userId} AND T.PRGRS_STTS_CD = 'TS030') AS myTocDone, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TOC T WHERE T.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND T.PIC_ID = #{userId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_ATCH_FILE F WHERE F.TOC_SN = T.TOC_SN AND F.DEL_YN = 'N')) AS myFileTocs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TOC T WHERE T.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND ) AS allTocTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TOC T WHERE T.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND AND T.PRGRS_STTS_CD = 'TS030') AS allTocDone FROM TB_BID_PBANC P LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD S ON S.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTS' AND S.CD = P.PBANC_STTS_CD WHERE P.PBANC_STTS_CD IN ('PS030', 'PS040') AND ORDER BY P.BID_DDLN_DT, P.PBANC_SN FETCH FIRST 30 ROWS ONLY
